text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for v3.13.2-canary — initial 4% in us-west-2. Change window 03/24 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: 4% -> 12% -> 30% -> 100%. Observations: 6m. Rollback if p95 > 900ms for 5m or errors > 1.2% for 3m.
Naomi: I'm release owner. tagging @qa @infra.
Dev: noted. new batching change included. watch requests >10k tokens.
Infra: pre-warmed q8 variant in us-west-2 standby. image id: img-zzz-q8.
Ravi: infra oncall here. I'll monitor LB and evictions.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 4% at 01:05 UTC.
Dev: seeing slight p95 bump to 720ms during cold starts, nothing sustained.
Naomi: proceed to 12% at 01:12 if stable. any objections?
Ravi: +0. I'll flag if eviction rate > 200/min.
Infra: FYI seeing one node with `conn reset` traces at 01:10, isolating.
Naomi: pause increase until node replaced. don't advance.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by Naomi at 01:14 UTC — reason: connection resets on one canary host.
Ravi: taking node out of rotation, replacing with q8 standby. running `infra replace --node n-7 --with img-zzz-q8`
Infra: replacement started at 01:16, healthchecks pending.
Dev: logs show KV churn tied to a single long-seq caller. may be workload spike.
Naomi: decision: hold at 4% until replacement healthy for 4m. no rollback. update release notes accordingly.
Ravi: node drained and removed at 01:19. q8 instance joined at 01:21 and passed healthchecks.
Infra: post-replace p95 ~ 680ms, errors 0.2%.
Naomi: good. resume to 12% at 01:28 if no new signals. I'll confirm at 01:27.
Dev: thumbs up. I'll keep an eye on long request traces and KV eviction graph: https://grafana.local/d/rls/evictions
Naomi: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
